meta_rows: Carstairs index of deprivation 2001 (based on data from 1999) - at age 53 years

Carstairs index of deprivation comprises of four indicator; lack of car ownership, low occupational social class and overcrowded households. Calculated for 2001 based on the closest year for the cohort 1999.
